sources.title: Elon Musk confirms Grok 4.2/4.20 size, April 8, 2026
sources.evidence: Official X syndication JSON fetched successfully; direct X page returned 403. Post dated April 8 14:59:46 UTC confirms Grok 4.2 at 0.5T in reply to a parent explicitly discussing Grok 4.20 and 500 billion parameters. Official system-card naming corroborates the 4.2 abbreviation. Retrieval: https://cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=2041893772683047215&lang=en&token=1 .

sources.title: Elon Musk clarifies Grok 4.20 total parameters, April 9, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh official X syndication JSON dated April 9 06:12:52 UTC explicitly states 0.5T total. Its embedded parent asks whether Grok 4.20 is 500B total or 500B active in a larger MoE. This resolves total-versus-active scope; it does not disclose active count or topology. Retrieval: https://cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=2042123561666855235&lang=en&token=1 .

patch.description: Grok 4.20 reasoning API model with text and image inputs, text output, and function calling.
patch.notes: The 0309 identifier denotes the snapshot; xAI's API launch is dated March 10, 2026. The nominal 500B total comes from founder disclosures on April 8–9, explicitly distinguishing total from active; the posts name Grok 4.20, mapped to the native 0309 identifier by official documentation. It is rounded, not an exact tensor count. Active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed. Native context is 1,000,000 tokens; provider limits can differ. PDF attachments use document search.

summary: Correct release to the explicit March 10 native API launch; add proprietary classification and the founder-disclosed nominal 500B total, remove PDF from native modalities, and replace the unsupported description. The later size disclosure explicitly names Grok 4.20 and clarifies total rather than active; exact snapshot mapping uses official native aliases. Retain one-million-token context, reasoning and function calling. Active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed. No weights or authenticated inference were fetched.
